ev.q: Compared with 2019, overall pediatric emergency department visits decreased by 51%, 22%, and 23% during 2020, 2021, and January 2022, respectively.
CDC selected 15 categories with the largest increases and decreases in number of mean weekly visits
VRs were calculated as the proportion of all ED visits in each diagnostic category during the pandemic surveillance period
compared them with corresponding weeks in 2019
and by three age groups (0–4, 5–11, and 12–17 years), and visit diagnoses
CDC assessed data from the National Syndromic Surveillance Program (NSSP)

methods_quotes.q: CIs that excluded 1 were considered statistically significant.
VRs were calculated as the proportion of all ED visits in each diagnostic category during the pandemic surveillance period
VRs were suppressed if there were <100 visits, the difference in visit counts between periods was <100, or the relative standard error was >30%.
analyses were restricted to facilities with a coefficient of variation ≤40 and average weekly informative discharge diagnosis ≥75% complete
a visit with multiple codes could be counted across more than one category
